status.summary: Former UFC light heavyweight title challenger (lost a unanimous decision to Jon Jones at UFC 247, Feb 8, 2020, scored 48-47, 48-47, 49-46, and a TKO to Jan Blachowicz for the vacant title at UFC 253). After four straight losses from 2020 to 2022 and a 19-month layoff, he is 5-1 since June 2024. He has won his last two: a split decision over Johnny Walker at UFC 327 (Apr 11, 2026, Miami) and a first-round TKO of Azamat Murzakanov at UFC 333 (Oct 24, 2026, Abu Dhabi), where a head kick hurt Murzakanov, a straight left dropped him and ground strikes ended it at 2:40. His only loss in that run is a first-round KO by Carlos Ulberg at UFC Perth (Sep 27, 2025). After UFC 333 he spent the week publicly feuding with commentator Daniel Cormier over the broadcast. No next bout is booked as of Nov 6, 2026 (he is on no UFC card in the ESPN schedule through Feb 2027 or the Sherdog events list). Pro record 17-5. No injury reported.

style.summary: A tall southpaw with real one-punch power: seven of his eleven UFC wins are KO/TKO, six of them in round 1, and he knocks opponents down at more than twice the division rate per head strike. He mixes in body work and low kicks and finishes on top when he can, but a fragile chin (four KO losses) makes every exchange high-risk.

moves.notes: Southpaw: 'cross' is his straight left, 'jab' his right, 'hook' a lead right hook. Each group sums to 1; the engine's target split picks the group. Decayed sums in fighters.json: significant attempts 71% head, 14% body, 15% legs; landed 63% head, 16% body, 21% legs (head accuracy 0.51, legs 0.82); career landed body share 24%. No scouting article on his punch selection was found, so the head weights are a generic southpaw-power profile with the rear straight on top; recaps of his recent knockouts name the straight left (MMA Junkie on Murzakanov: 'snipes ... with straight left'), and the head kick was raised to 0.10 (overhand cut to 0.06) after a head kick set up the Murzakanov finish (MMA Fighting, Oct 24, 2026). Body kicks lead the body group on the Jones fight (48/55 body landed, mostly at distance). Leg kicks split evenly for lack of a source on the target. Clinch strikes are 6% of decayed attempts, so knee and elbow are small; ground work shows up as ground-and-pound, not elbows specifically. No spinning techniques recorded. Sources: data/derived/fighters.json; ufcstats per-fight totals in data/raw.

engine_notes.note: Power: 2.7 knockdowns per 100 significant head strikes landed (decayed), 2.4 career, against a light heavyweight league rate of 1.3; the highest of this group.

Chin: 2.9 knockdowns absorbed per 100 head strikes taken (decayed), 1.9 career; 4 knockdowns absorbed and 4 KO/TKO losses in 16 UFC fights. He is hit less than most (2.9 absorbed per minute decayed), but what lands hurts him.
Takedown defense 91% decayed and 83% career; control against him is 26 s per 15 min decayed, far below the 154 s light heavyweight league rate.
In 5-round fights his landed rate relative to round 1 runs 1.00, 1.20, 1.29, 0.65, 1.05 (minute-weighted; only the Jones fight reached rounds 3-5, so those three values are one fight).
Against Walker his output rose late and switched to the legs: 10, 9 and 15 significant strikes landed by round, with 12 of 15 leg strikes in round 3.
